evals.prompt: How do I add the official anthropics/skills marketplace and install document-skills without blindly copying all 19 folders?
evals.expected_outcome: Provides /plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills, /plugin install document-skills@anthropic-agent-skills, and checks local jeo-skills equivalents first.
assertions: Suggests selective plugin or folder install instead of bulk copy
Notes local jeo-skills counterparts like pdf/docx/mcp-builder

evals.prompt: What license rules apply before redistributing skills copied from anthropics/skills?
evals.expected_outcome: Points to per-skill LICENSE.txt (Apache-2.0) and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md (BSD-2-Clause and embedded package notices).

evals.prompt: Validate a new .agent-skills/<name>/SKILL.md against jeo-skills skills.json and frontmatter rules.
assertions: Routes jeo-skills manifest/frontmatter validation to skill-standardization
